title: Operate & troubleshoot
breadcrumb: Federation Hub: connecting multiple TAK Servers

blocks.html:
Watch the federation

  • Active Connections — the double-arrow toolbar icon (or a node → Show Active Connections) lists every live link: connection id, local/remote type (FEDERATION_HUB_SERVER ↔ FEDERATION_TAK_CLIENT), remote address, federation protocol version, and group identities. You can Disconnect a federate here.
  • Metrics Dashboard — heap, CPU, total connections, and network I/O (reads/writes), with a short history.

Resilience: Mission Federation Disruption Tolerance (MFDT)

If you enabled the optional MongoDB, the hub stores and forwards Data Sync / mission changes that happen while a federate (or another hub) is disconnected, and delivers them on reconnect. Without it, mission changes during an outage are lost. Enable it when deployments federate over unreliable links.

Blocking files across the federation

Federated data packages and missions can carry files you may not want crossing deployments. TAK Server's Data Package and Mission File Blocker blocks configured file extensions in federated content (default **.pref**, since device-profile prefs shouldn't leak between deployments). Configure it on the federating TAK Servers.

Settings

The hub Settings page offers Download Self CA (grab ca.pem from the browser) and Restart Broker (restart the messaging micro-service).

Troubleshooting

Symptom Likely cause
Federate can't connect / connection refused The server isn't in the active policy. Add its CA Group and re-upload the policy (cloud icon).
Connects (green node) but no data flows Group filtering. For anything beyond Allow All, the source must run group mapping; check the edge's Allowed/Disallowed groups and that both sides use the same group names.
TLS / cert errors CA not shared both ways — re-check Establish trust (server CA → hub, hub CA → server's federation truststore).
Changes don't take effect You edited the graph but didn't save + upload the policy.
mTLS impossible on the network Switch that link to token auth (port 9103; CA Group Allow Token Auth or a Token Group).
Mission edits lost after an outage Enable MFDT (MongoDB).
